text: The evening clerk counted dry cedar planks along the north bench then wiped the sawdust from the ledger and wrote the date in the margin of the grey book while the yard gate stayed closed and the tram bells faded behind the laboratory wall after a late rain on the clay path that had already dried in the wind from the river.
